# **II. Software Design Document** {#ii.-software-design-document}

## **1\. System Design** {#1.-system-design}

### **1.1 System Architecture** {#1.1-system-architecture}

![][image2]

***Figure 1.1.*** *UAV-PMS System Architecture.*

UAV-PMS adopts a distributed microservices and event-driven architecture organized into four zones: Frontend & Field Clients, a Dockerized .NET 9 Backend on a Linux VPS, Data/Messaging & Cloud AI Infrastructure, and an automated CI/CD Pipeline.

**Architecture Components**

| No | Component | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | Web Console (Angular 21 SPA) | Role-based web portal hosted on Vercel CDN; uses Leaflet GIS to render power-grid maps over Google/OSM HTTPS tiles. |
| 02 | UAV / Field Client & DuckDNS | Edge/UAV client sending telemetry and inspection media over HTTPS; DuckDNS resolves `uavpms.ddns.net` to the VPS IP. |
| 03 | Nginx Proxy | Public reverse proxy terminating SSL/TLS and forwarding HTTPS/WSS traffic to the API Gateway. |
| 04 | Ocelot API Gateway | Unified entry point routing HTTP REST and WebSocket requests to downstream services with aggregated Swagger UI. |
| 05 | .NET Core APIs (REST & MediatR) | Core CQRS microservices (`Identity`, `Operations`, `AIInspection`, `Notification`) handling business workflows and REST APIs. |
| 06 | gRPC Server (Risk Evaluation) | Internal service (`InspectionEvaluationService`) evaluating AI defect severity and risk levels over gRPC (HTTP/2). |
| 07 | SignalR Hub & EF Core + Hangfire | Pushes real-time WebSocket notifications (SignalR), manages ORM persistence (EF Core), and runs background jobs (Hangfire). |
| 08 | PostgreSQL + PostGIS & Redis Cache | Primary spatial/relational database (`:5432`) and in-memory Redis cache (`:6379`) for OTPs and session throttling. |
| 09 | RabbitMQ Broker & MinIO S3 Storage | AMQP message broker (`:5672` with DLQ) for async domain/AI events, and S3 object storage (`uav-media`) for inspection media. |
| 10 | Python AI Worker, Modal GPU & Brevo | FastAPI worker (`:8000`) consuming RabbitMQ jobs and reading MinIO media to run YOLO11/RT-DETR inference on Modal Cloud GPU; Brevo API sends OTP/alert emails. |
| 11 | CI/CD & Deployment Pipeline | GitHub Actions builds/tests code and triggers SSH Deploy to update Docker Compose containers on the Linux VPS. |

***Table 1.1.*** *System architecture components description.*

*![][image3]*

***Figure 1\.** Overall Sub-systems Package Diagram.*

**Package Descriptions**

| No | Package | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | UavPms_FE (Web Client) | Angular 21 SPA client using NG-ZORRO, Tailwind CSS v4, Leaflet/MapLibre GIS, and SignalR Client; communicates with the API Gateway over HTTPS/WSS. |
| 02 | UavPms.ApiGateway | Ocelot reverse proxy (.NET 9) providing unified HTTP REST and WebSocket routing, CORS enforcement, and aggregated Swagger documentation. |
| 03 | FastAPI AI Worker | Python FastAPI worker (:8000) acting as a RabbitMQ job consumer and Modal Cloud GPU client for asynchronous deep-learning defect inference. |
| 04 | IdentityService | Handles user authentication, JWT issuance/rotation, 5-role RBAC authorization, Redis-backed 6-digit OTP verification, and Brevo email delivery. |
| 05 | OperationsService | Manages GIS regions/towers, UAV fleet, pre-mission readiness assessments, mission dispatch/execution, maintenance tickets, and executive reports. |
| 06 | NotificationService | Manages user notifications, real-time WebSocket broadcasts via SignalR Hub, and recurring/scheduled background jobs via Hangfire. |
| 07 | AIInspectionService | Orchestrates AI analysis jobs, detected anomalies, Vision Bridge edge ingestion, and MinIO S3 media storage; calls InspectionEvaluationService via gRPC. |
| 08 | InspectionEvaluationService | Internal gRPC server (:8080) hosting the severity and risk evaluation engine for AI defect detections. |
| 09 | UavPms.Shared.Contracts | Shared contract library referenced by the core .NET microservices, containing Constants, Events & Outbox, Interfaces, Media, and Settings. |

## **2\. Database Design** {#2.-database-design}

![][image11]

***Figure 10\.** UAV-PMS Physical Entity-Relationship Diagram (PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS).*

***Table Descriptions***

| No | Table | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 01 | Users | Stores account information for personnel in the UAV-PMS system (Administrators, Managers, Inspectors, Pilots, Technicians, Analysts). Enforces unique indexes on Email and active Phone. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: None |
| 02 | Roles | Defines system roles for Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), including SystemAdmin, Manager, Inspector, Analyst, Technician. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: None |
| 03 | UserRoles | Junction table establishing the many-to-many relationship between users and roles. • Primary Key: Composite (UserId, RoleId) • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id; RoleId → Roles.Id |
| 04 | RefreshTokens | Stores cryptographic refresh tokens supporting secure JWT token rotation and session revocation. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id |
| 05 | TrustedDevices | Manages 30-day trusted browser and client device fingerprints, enabling persistent authentication without requiring repeated OTP verification. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id |
| 06 | Regions | Stores hierarchical administrative and operational territories (City, District, Ward) with spatial boundary polygons (geometry(Polygon/MultiPolygon, 4326)). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: ParentId → Regions.Id |
| 07 | UserGeographicScopes | Manages GIS operational territory assignments per user, enforcing multi-tenant geographic data isolation across regional boundaries. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id; RegionId → Regions.Id |
| 08 | Towers | Stores electrical transmission and distribution towers, including unique tower code, structural pole type, address, and spatial coordinates (geometry(Point, 4326)). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: RegionId → Regions.Id |
| 09 | UAVs | Stores UAV fleet equipment, technical specifications (range, endurance, battery level), operational status (Available, InMission, Maintenance), and current coordinates. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AssignedRegionId → Regions.Id; LastTechnicalInspectionId → DroneTechnicalInspections.Id |
| 10 | DroneFlightControllers | Manages handheld remote flight controllers (RC units), tracking hardware pairing status and lifecycle history with specific UAVs. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: DroneId → UAVs.Id |
| 11 | DroneTechnicalInspections | Records periodic pre-flight and technical inspection certificates for UAVs, capturing technical snapshots and validation decisions. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: DroneId → UAVs.Id; TechnicianId → Users.Id |
| 12 | DroneTechnicalMetrics | Stores granular diagnostic sensor measurements during UAV inspections (motor vibration, battery degradation, IMU drift, compass calibration). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: InspectionId → DroneTechnicalInspections.Id |
| 13 | InspectionSchedules | Stores automated recurring inspection policies and scheduling rules defined via iCalendar RFC-5545 recurrence rules (RRULE). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: RegionId → Regions.Id |
| 14 | PreMissionAssessments | Stores feasibility assessments evaluating airspace clearance, weather, tower conditions, and resource readiness prior to mission authorization. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: ManagerId → Users.Id; RegionId → Regions.Id |
| 15 | PreMissionAssessmentTowers | Maps electrical towers evaluated during a pre-mission feasibility assessment, tracking sequence and individual tower inspection feasibility. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AssessmentId → PreMissionAssessments.Id; TowerId → Towers.Id |
| 16 | PreMissionAssessmentPersonnel | Records flight crew and technical candidate evaluations during assessment, tracking readiness, regional authorization, availability, and schedule conflicts. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AssessmentId → PreMissionAssessments.Id; UserId → Users.Id |
| 17 | PreMissionAssessmentDrones | Records UAV equipment candidate assessments, linking valid BIST technical certificates and battery endurance projections. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AssessmentId → PreMissionAssessments.Id; DroneId → UAVs.Id; TechnicalInspectionId → DroneTechnicalInspections.Id |
| 18 | Missions | Stores UAV inspection missions, including planned/actual schedules, operational status (Draft, Assigned, InProgress, Completed, Postponed), and operational parameters. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: ManagerId → Users.Id; RegionId → Regions.Id; UavId → UAVs.Id; ScheduleId → InspectionSchedules.Id; PreMissionAssessmentId → PreMissionAssessments.Id |
| 19 | MissionTargets | Defines scheduled electrical towers for an active mission, maintaining route sequence order, inspection timestamps, and completion state. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; TowerId → Towers.Id |
| 20 | MissionPriorityDefects | Defines target defect categories designated as critical focus areas for an inspection mission. • Primary Key: Composite (MissionId, CategoryId) • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; CategoryId → DefectCategories.Id |
| 21 | MissionAssignments | Manages operational personnel assignments (Inspector, Pilot, Analyst), response deadlines, and acceptance/postponement acknowledgments. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; UserId → Users.Id; AssignedById → Users.Id |
| 22 | ResourceBookings | Enforces temporal exclusive reservations on UAVs and assigned flight crew to prevent scheduling double-booking conflicts across overlapping mission windows. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; UserId → Users.Id; DroneId → UAVs.Id |
| 23 | MissionCheckIns | Records on-site GPS geofence check-in events executed by flight teams upon arriving at designated field towers. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; UserId → Users.Id |
| 24 | DroneHandovers | Tracks chain-of-custody transfer records and physical return receipts for UAV equipment between base station custodians and field operators. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; DroneId → UAVs.Id; HandedOverBy → Users.Id; ReceivedBy → Users.Id |
| 25 | MissionFlightLogs | Stores flight telemetry logs collected during mission execution (flight time, battery consumption curves, altitude profiles, speed distributions). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id |
| 26 | MissionCommunicationLogs | Provides mission-scoped messaging and dispatch instruction logs between central command and field crew. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; SenderId → Users.Id |
| 27 | IncidentReports | Documents unexpected anomalies occurring during flight (bird strikes, electromagnetic interference, forced emergency landings, extreme weather disruptions). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; ReportedBy → Users.Id; TowerId → Towers.Id |
| 28 | InspectionMedia | Stores metadata for captured aerial imagery and videos, maintaining MinIO S3 storage keys, image resolutions, SHA-256 checksums, and EXIF GPS capture locations. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MissionId → Missions.Id; TowerId → Towers.Id; UploadedBy → Users.Id |
| 29 | AIAnalysisRuns | Tracks AI inference jobs executed on edge devices (Edge) or the central Cloud GPU server (Cloud), maintaining execution location, batch IDs, model versions, and completion status. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: MediaId → InspectionMedia.Id; UavId → UAVs.Id; RequestedBy → Users.Id |
| 30 | DefectCategories | Master catalog of standardized electrical grid defects (CORROSION, CRACK, HOTSPOT, VEGETATION, BIRD\_NEST, BROKEN\_INSULATOR), defining severity weights and emergency escalation criteria. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: None |
| 31 | DetectedAnomalies | Stores defect instances detected by AI models or manual inspection, containing normalized bounding box coordinates (X, Y, Width, Height), confidence scores, crop image keys, and expert human validation state. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AnalysisRunId → AIAnalysisRuns.Id; MediaId → InspectionMedia.Id; TowerId → Towers.Id; CategoryId → DefectCategories.Id; AnalystId → Users.Id; SupersededById → DetectedAnomalies.Id |
| 32 | EmergencyAlerts | Manages real-time high-priority alerts triggered by confirmed safety-critical anomalies (e.g., structural cracks, high-temperature hotspots, broken insulator strings). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AnomalyId → DetectedAnomalies.Id; ReviewedById → Users.Id |
| 33 | AlertEscalations | Records escalation audit trails when critical alerts remain unacknowledged beyond threshold SLA windows, notifying senior operations managers. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AlertId → EmergencyAlerts.Id; EscalatedBy → Users.Id; EscalatedTo → Users.Id |
| 34 | MaintenanceTickets | Manages repair and corrective maintenance work orders spawned directly from validated anomalies, tracking remediation lifecycle from Open to Closed. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: AnomalyId → DetectedAnomalies.Id; ManagerId → Users.Id; TechnicianId → Users.Id |
| 35 | MaintenanceProofs | Stores verifiable photographic and video evidence captured before, during, and after repair procedures to substantiate maintenance sign-off. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: TicketId → MaintenanceTickets.Id; UploadedBy → Users.Id |
| 36 | MaterialLogs | Tracks specialized replacement parts, insulator bells, hardware clamps, and maintenance materials consumed during repair ticket execution. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: TicketId → MaintenanceTickets.Id; LoggedBy → Users.Id |
| 37 | Reports | Stores comprehensive executive inspection and periodic maintenance reports. When status is Approved, a frozen immutable JSONB snapshot is archived for regulatory auditing. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: RegionId → Regions.Id; CreatedBy → Users.Id; ApprovedById → Users.Id |
| 38 | ReportMissions | Junction table associating multiple executed inspection missions into aggregated periodic management reports. • Primary Key: Composite (ReportId, MissionId) • Foreign Keys: ReportId → Reports.Id; MissionId → Missions.Id |
| 39 | Notifications | Stores user-specific operational notifications dispatched via SignalR WebSocket and email channels, tracking read and delivery timestamps. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id |
| 40 | AuditLogs | Stores immutable security audit logs capturing user mutations, client IP addresses, entity state transitions, and differential JSON payloads. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: UserId → Users.Id |
| 41 | SystemSettings | Dynamic key-value configuration store for runtime operational thresholds (AI confidence cutoffs, session timeouts, notification retry limits, SLA escalation windows). • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: None |
| 42 | OutboxMessages | Implements the Transactional Outbox pattern, persisting integration domain events within local PostgreSQL transactions before reliable publication to RabbitMQ. • Primary Key: Id • Foreign Keys: None |
| 43 | base_entity_audit (Shared Audit Mixin) | Standard audit and soft-delete column group (created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at) inherited by all domain tables except Roles, UserRoles, DefectCategories, MissionPriorityDefects, ReportMissions, Notifications, AuditLogs, and OutboxMessages. |

***Table 10\.** Database tables description.*

## **3\. Detailed Design** {#3.-detailed-design}

This section presents the detailed class and sequence designs for the four core operational features (MF01–MF04) implemented across `OperationsService`, `AIInspectionService`, and `InspectionEvaluationService`. Secondary CRUD and administrative modules (such as Identity/User management, Region/Tower catalog, UAV Fleet management, and Schedule/Report management) follow the same Clean Architecture / CQRS pattern (`Controller -> MediatR Handler or Service -> Repository / ApplicationDbContext -> BaseEntity`) and therefore refer to the structural and behavioral designs below.

### **3.1 MF01 – Pre-Mission Feasibility and Resource Readiness** {#3.1-mf01-–-pre-mission-feasibility-and-resource-readiness}

Evaluates site feasibility, target towers, personnel availability, and UAV technical inspection readiness before a mission can be created.

#### ***3.1.1 Class Diagram***

![MF01 Class Diagram](/home/an/RiderProjects/UavPms_Org/docs/diagrams/Detailed%20Design/3.1.1_MF01_Class_Diagram.svg)

***Figure 11\.** MF01 – Pre-Mission Feasibility and Resource Readiness Class Diagram.*

***Class Specifications***

| No | Class | Description & Key Members |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | **PreMissionAssessmentController** | API controller exposing endpoints to create, evaluate, and convert assessments into missions. Methods: `Create()`, `Evaluate()`, `CreateMission()`. |
| 2 | **DroneTechnicalInspectionController** | API controller for submitting and retrieving pre-flight UAV technical inspections. Methods: `SubmitInspection()`, `GetLatestInspection()`. |
| 3 | **PreMissionAssessmentService** | Orchestrates site feasibility checks, personnel/UAV eligibility, and readiness status persistence. Methods: `CreateAsync()`, `EvaluateAsync()`, `CreateMissionFromAssessmentAsync()`. |
| 4 | **DroneTechnicalInspectionService** | Manages UAV health inspection records and evaluates pass/fail technical criteria. Methods: `SubmitInspectionAsync()`, `GetLatestInspectionAsync()`. |
| 5 | **DroneReadinessEvaluator** | Domain service evaluating UAV readiness from airframe status and latest technical inspection. Methods: `Evaluate()`, `IsEligibleForMission()`. |
| 6 | **ApplicationDbContext** | EF Core DbContext managing PostgreSQL/PostGIS persistence for assessments, towers, and inspections. Method: `SaveChangesAsync()`. |
| 7 | **PreMissionAssessment** | Core entity storing planned window, proposed GIS boundary, feasibility status, and lifecycle state (`Draft`, `Ready`, `Consumed`). |
| 8 | **PreMissionAssessmentTower** | Child entity linking a `PreMissionAssessment` to target transmission towers (`AssessmentId`, `TowerId`). |
| 9 | **DroneTechnicalInspection** | Entity recording battery health, calibration checks, overall result, and inspection timestamp for a UAV. |
| 10 | **BaseEntity** | Abstract base class providing shared primary key (`Id: Guid`) and audit timestamps (`CreatedAt`, `UpdatedAt`). |

***Table 11\.** MF01 – Pre-Mission Feasibility and Resource Readiness Class Specifications.*

### **3.2 MF02 – Create and Assign Inspection Mission** {#3.2-mf02---create-and-assign-inspection-mission}

Converts a Ready pre-mission assessment into an inspection mission, assigns field personnel and UAVs, and locks exclusive resource bookings.

#### ***3.2.1 Class Diagram***

![MF02 Class Diagram](/home/an/RiderProjects/UavPms_Org/docs/diagrams/Detailed%20Design/3.2.1_MF02_Class_Diagram.svg)

***Figure 13\.** MF02 – Create and Assign Inspection Mission Class Diagram.*

***Class Specifications***

| No | Class | Description & Key Members |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | **MissionController** | API controller handling mission creation, GIS scope resolution, crew assignment, and UAV allocation. Methods: `CreateFromAssessment()`, `Assign()`, `AssignDrone()`. |
| 2 | **CreateMissionFromAssessmentCommandHandler** | MediatR command handler converting a Ready `PreMissionAssessment` into an executable `Mission`. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 3 | **MissionLifecycleService** | Coordinates mission scope confirmation, resource assignment, and state transitions. Methods: `AssignAsync()`, `AssignDroneAsync()`, `ResolveScopeAsync()`. |
| 4 | **MissionResourceGuard** | Domain service enforcing conflict-free scheduling by validating overlapping personnel and UAV bookings. Methods: `EnsurePersonnelAvailable()`, `EnsureDroneAvailable()`. |
| 5 | **IMissionRealtimeNotifier** | Abstraction broadcasting mission creation and assignment updates to clients via `NotificationService`/SignalR. Method: `NotifyMissionUpdatedAsync()`. |
| 6 | **ApplicationDbContext** | EF Core DbContext persisting missions, targets, assignments, and exclusive resource bookings atomically. |
| 7 | **Mission** | Aggregate root entity representing an inspection mission (`MissionCode`, `Title`, `UavId`, `Status`, `StartedAt`). |
| 8 | **MissionAssignment** | Entity mapping assigned field personnel (Inspector, Pilot) and their acceptance status to a `Mission`. |
| 9 | **MissionTarget** | Entity defining ordered transmission towers (`Sequence`, `InspectionStatus`) to be inspected in a `Mission`. |
| 10 | **ResourceBooking** | Entity locking personnel and UAV time windows (`ResourceType`, `ResourceId`, `StartAt`, `EndAt`) to prevent double-booking. |

***Table 12\.** MF02 – Create and Assign Inspection Mission Class Specifications.*

### **3.3 MF03 – Execute Mission and Perform Field Inspection** {#3.3-mf03---execute-mission-and-perform-field-inspection}

Supports on-site GPS check-in, mission execution lifecycle (`Start`, `Complete`), target tower progress tracking, and deduplicated inspection media upload to MinIO object storage.

#### ***3.3.1 Class Diagram***

![MF03 Class Diagram](/home/an/RiderProjects/UavPms_Org/docs/diagrams/Detailed%20Design/Class%20Diagram/3.3.1_MF03_Class_Diagram.svg)

***Figure 15\.** MF03 – Execute Mission and Perform Field Inspection Class Diagram.*

***Class Specifications***

| No | Class | Description & Key Members |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | **MissionController** | API controller exposing field execution endpoints for GPS check-in and mission start/completion. Methods: `CheckIn()`, `Start()`, `Complete()`. |
| 2 | **InspectionController** | API controller handling multipart RGB/thermal inspection media uploads and mission media queries. Methods: `UploadImage()`, `GetByMission()`. |
| 3 | **FieldCheckInCommandHandler** | MediatR handler verifying assignee authorization and GPS proximity before recording check-in and transitioning mission status. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 4 | **UploadInspectionImageCommandHandler** | MediatR handler validating file MIME/size, computing SHA-256 checksum for deduplication, uploading to MinIO, and saving metadata. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 5 | **IUnitOfWork / Repositories** | Persistence abstraction (`IMissionRepository`, `ITowerRepository`, `IGenericRepository<T>`) ensuring transactional writes via `SaveChangesAsync()`. |
| 6 | **MinioFileStorageService** | Implements `IFileStorageService` to store inspection images/videos in MinIO object storage and compute SHA-256 checksums. |
| 7 | **Mission** | Aggregate root entity tracking mission execution state (`MissionCode`, `Status`, `StartedAt`). |
| 8 | **MissionCheckIn** | Entity storing GPS check-in coordinates (PostGIS `Point`), inspector `UserId`, and `CheckedInAt` timestamp. |
| 9 | **MissionTarget** | Entity tracking per-tower inspection progress (`MissionId`, `TowerId`, `Sequence`, `InspectionStatus`) during field execution. |
| 10 | **InspectionMedia** | Entity storing uploaded media metadata (`MissionId`, `TowerId`, `FileUrl`, SHA-256 `Checksum`) with unique `(mission_id, checksum)` constraint. |

***Table 13\.** MF03 – Execute Mission and Perform Field Inspection Class Specifications.*

### **3.4 MF04 – AI Inspection and Defect Detection** {#3.4-mf04---ai-inspection-and-defect-detection}

Orchestrates asynchronous AI defect inference, gRPC threshold severity evaluation, analyst review, and maintenance ticket/alert escalation via transactional outbox and RabbitMQ.

#### ***3.4.1 Class Diagram***

![MF04 Class Diagram](/home/an/RiderProjects/UavPms_Org/docs/diagrams/Detailed%20Design/3.4.1_MF04_Class_Diagram.svg)

***Figure 18\.** MF04 – AI Inspection and Defect Detection Class Diagram.*

***Class Specifications***

| No | Class | Description & Key Members |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | **AIAnalysisController** | API controller triggering AI analysis on mission media, listing detections, and submitting analyst reviews. Methods: `AnalyzeExistingMedia()`, `GetMissionAiDetections()`, `ReviewMissionAiDetection()`. |
| 2 | **AnomaliesController** | API controller for anomaly validation and GIS tower assignment. Methods: `ValidateAnomaly()`, `AssignTower()`. |
| 3 | **AnalyzeExistingMediaCommandHandler** | MediatR handler creating an `AIAnalysisRun` (`Pending`) and enqueuing an outbox/RabbitMQ analysis job. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 4 | **ProcessAiAnalysisResultCommandHandler** | MediatR handler processing Cloud AI inference callbacks, invoking gRPC threshold evaluation, and persisting `DetectedAnomaly` records. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 5 | **ReviewMissionAiDetectionCommandHandler** | MediatR handler recording analyst approve/reject decisions, escalating confirmed defects to `MaintenanceTicket`/`EmergencyAlert`, and publishing domain events. Method: `Handle()`. |
| 6 | **GrpcInspectionEvaluationClient** | gRPC client (`IInspectionEvaluationClient`) calling `InspectionEvaluationService` with a 3-second deadline. Method: `EvaluateAsync()`. |
| 7 | **InspectionEvaluationGrpcService** | gRPC server evaluating raw detection confidence and defect category against configurable thresholds to assign severity. Method: `EvaluateDetection()`. |
| 8 | **IEventPublisher (RabbitMQ)** | Messaging abstraction publishing `AnomalyValidatedEvent` and analysis events to RabbitMQ for `NotificationService`. |
| 9 | **AIAnalysisRun** | Entity tracking an AI inference lifecycle (`MediaId`, `ModelName`, `Status`, `StartedAt`, `CompletedAt`). |
| 10 | **DetectedAnomaly / OutboxMessage / MaintenanceTicket** | Core entities storing detected defect bounding boxes/severities, transactional outbox events (`jsonb`), and escalated maintenance tickets. |

***Table 14\.** MF04 – AI Inspection and Defect Detection Class Specifications.*
